item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 24/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Gaemi's outer subsiding air will continue to bring very hot weather to southern China tomorrow. High temperatures may also trigger thundery showers. Gaemi is expected to move across Taiwan and towards Fujian tonight and tomorrow. Meanwhile, the southwesterly airstream over the northern part of the South China Sea will become active. Showers will increase with a few squally thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong on Friday and during the weekend. A broad trough of low pressure will bring heavy showers to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China early next week.

Weather: Very hot with sunny periods. Isolated showers and squally thunderstorms at night.

PSR: Medium Low
